questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: A peptide synthesized by the reactions of one molecule each of Glycine, Leucine, Aspartic acid and Histidine will have _________ peptide linkages.
questions.explanation:
Combination of n amino acids gives a polypeptide with (n – 1) peptide linkages.

Similarly combination of four amino acids gives a tetrapeptide with three peptide linkages.
